newsitem.title: UK: UK bookmakers lengthen odds on Conservative win.
newsitem.headline: UK bookmakers lengthen odds on Conservative win.

text.p: The odds on Britain's ruling Conservatives winning the next election have been lengthened to 9-4 from 2-1, the longest odds for six months. bookmakers William Hill said on Wednesday.
The odds on Labour winning an election due by May 22 have been cut to 1-3 from 3-10. Labour has a huge lead over the Conservatives in opinion polls.

"Despite a generally well-received Budget, opinion polls are not reflecting an upturn in Tory (Conservative) fortunes," a spokesman said. May, quoted at 2-5, is rated as the most likely month for the election to take place.
